[[Category:McDonalds Chapel Cemetery, Jefferson County, Alabama]]
== Biography ==
Mary was born in 1829.  She passed away in 1898.

Mary Amanda (Glasgow) McDonald was the daughter of Robert Glasgow and Elizabeth Goggans. She and Jacob McDonald were married in 1850 or 1851 probably in Floyd Co., GA. They lived in Adairsville, Bartow Co., GA until 1865, when they moved to Jefferson Co., AL with Jacob's parents, the Rev. William and Mary (Gravitt) McDonald. William was the founder and first pastor of McDonald Chapel.
